summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K to disclose a routine total voting rights update under UK DGTR 5.5.1. On 10 April 2026, 355,880 ordinary shares (US$0.25 par) were transferred from treasury for employee share scheme distributions. Treasury shares now total 784,211,237, representing 4.99% of total voting rights; total voting rights stand at 15,707,184,257. No special-situation event is involved—this is a standard regulatory disclosure. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. The filing is purely informational, with no action for shareholders or next-watch items.
